mkdir -p /workspace/out
python3 -m pip install -q --disable-pip-version-check "torch==2.4.1" "transformers==4.51.3" "trl==0.18.2" "peft==0.15.2" "accelerate==1.6.0" "datasets==3.5.1" "huggingface_hub==0.30.2" "safetensors==0.5.3" "bitsandbytes==0.45.5" "tokenizers==0.21.1" "numpy==1.26.4" "pyarrow==19.0.1" "pandas==2.2.3"
python3 -m pip check
python3 -u - <<'TRAIN'
import os, time, json, torch, importlib.metadata, requests
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from trl import SFTTrainer, SFTConfig
from peft import LoraConfig
from huggingface_hub import HfApi
from huggingface_hub.utils import build_hf_headers, hf_raise_for_status
BASE = "Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B"
BASE_REVISION = "70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e"
CANDIDATE = "SZLHOLDINGS/salad-abstention-sft-v1-r1"
DATASET = "SZLHOLDINGS/szl-distill-abstention-v1-sft"
DATASET_REVISION = "4f0f42a44cd6af1f21ac269a3bf5b396e0c12c14"
RUN = "salad-abstention-sft-v1-r1"
t0 = time.time()
api = HfApi(endpoint="https://huggingface.co", token=os.environ["HF_TOKEN"])
auth_metadata = api.whoami().get("auth", {})
api.auth_check(BASE, repo_type="model")
api.auth_check(DATASET, repo_type="dataset")
if not api.model_info(CANDIDATE).private:
    raise RuntimeError("Existing candidate repository must remain private")
# Hub 0.30.2 has no write keyword; this is the exact endpoint used by current HfApi.auth_check(write=True).
write_check = requests.get("https://huggingface.co/api/models/" + CANDIDATE + "/auth-check/write", headers=build_hf_headers(token=os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]), timeout=30)
hf_raise_for_status(write_check)
print("AUTH_PREFLIGHT", json.dumps({"candidate": CANDIDATE, "candidate_private": True, "dataset_read": True, "candidate_write": True, "credential_type": auth_metadata.get("type"), "credential_expires_at": auth_metadata.get("expiresAt")}), flush=True)
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BASE, revision=BASE_REVISION)
ds = load_dataset(DATASET, revision=DATASET_REVISION, split="train")
print("corpus:", len(ds), "examples")
def fmt(ex):
    if "text" in ex: return {"text": ex["text"]}
    if "messages" in ex: return {"text": tok.apply_chat_template(ex["messages"], tokenize=False)}
    if "question" in ex and "ideal_response" in ex:
        msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": ex["question"]}, {"role": "assistant", "content": ex["ideal_response"]}]
        return {"text": tok.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=False)}
    if "prompt" in ex and "completion" in ex: return {"text": ex["prompt"] + ex["completion"]}
    return {"text": json.dumps(ex)}
ds = ds.map(fmt, remove_columns=ds.column_names)
peft_cfg = LoraConfig(r=32, lora_alpha=64, lora_dropout=0.05, target_modules=["q_proj","k_proj","v_proj","o_proj","gate_proj","up_proj","down_proj"], task_type="CAUSAL_LM")
cfg = SFTConfig(output_dir="/workspace/out/lane", max_length=2048, per_device_train_batch_size=4, gradient_accumulation_steps=8, learning_rate=2e-4, lr_scheduler_type="cosine", warmup_ratio=0.03, logging_steps=20, save_steps=200, save_total_limit=6, bf16=True, optim="adamw_torch", num_train_epochs=6, report_to=[], packing=True, max_steps=2000)
runtime_versions = {p: importlib.metadata.version(p) for p in ["torch", "transformers", "trl", "peft", "accelerate", "datasets", "huggingface_hub", "safetensors", "bitsandbytes", "tokenizers", "numpy", "pyarrow", "pandas"]}
print("PREFLIGHT", json.dumps({"run": RUN, "base": BASE, "base_revision": BASE_REVISION, "dataset": DATASET, "dataset_revision": DATASET_REVISION, "corpus_examples": len(ds), "runtime_versions": runtime_versions, "cuda_available": torch.cuda.is_available(), "training_qualified": False, "hold_reason": "independent evaluation and governed training manifest required"}), flush=True)
if os.environ.get("SZL_TRAINING_MODE", "preflight") != "train":
    print("TRAINING_HELD preflight complete; no optimizer steps or artifact uploads", flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(BASE, revision=BASE_REVISION, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="auto")
trainer = SFTTrainer(model=model, args=cfg, train_dataset=ds, peft_config=peft_cfg, processing_class=tok)
trainer.train()
print("TRAIN_DONE hours=", round((time.time()-t0)/3600, 2))
trainer.save_model("/workspace/out/lane/final")
api.upload_folder(folder_path="/workspace/out/lane/final", repo_id=CANDIDATE, repo_type="model")
report = {"run":RUN, "base":BASE, "base_revision":BASE_REVISION, "corpus_examples":len(ds), "dataset":DATASET, "dataset_revision":DATASET_REVISION, "runtime_versions":runtime_versions, "wall_hours":round((time.time()-t0)/3600,2), "gpu":"assigned-gpu", "method":"LoRA r32 a64 bf16", "curriculum":"abstention seed corpus szl-distill-abstention-v1 (v1-spec regeneration, disclosed 2026-11-16; bounded max_steps=2000)", "started_utc":time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(t0))}
open("/workspace/out/lane/training_report.json","w").write(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
api.upload_file(path_or_fileobj="/workspace/out/lane/training_report.json", path_in_repo="training_report.json", repo_id=CANDIDATE, repo_type="model")
print("PUBLISHED", CANDIDATE)
TRAIN
echo LANE_COMPLETE
